description: This file defines a PHP trait 'HasMonitoringEventsTrait' that provides methods for managing client-side monitoring events, including retrieving, prepending, and appending events to an internal array.

methods.name: getMonitoringEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of monitoring events attached to the object.

methods.name: prependMonitoringEvent
methods.description: Prepends an event to the monitoringEvents array.

methods.name: appendMonitoringEvent
methods.description: Appends an event to the monitoringEvents array.
